data.creator_notes:
Really liked the idea of card and 1 particular roleplay scenario of mine. Modified card was collecting dust on my shelf for over 4 months until I finally decided to publish it.

Changes:
I've rewritten defs of card entirely, removing most of other characters and fleshing Lilith out  in greater detail. Also deleted all intros mentioning named Relief Urinals from original and trimmed lore book.

Have fun!

---

Original Creator's notes:
```
This is a multiple character card with a centered on watersport (human urinal) and sexual slavery. Instead of the usual 1 character with multiple greetings depicting different situations, I thought I'd flip the script around focusing on a single setting with multiple characters.

The greetings are fairly lengthy this time around as I use them to set the stage. For context, 'Extra Service' refers to the private time you can purchase by notifying the staff, and 'Buyout' refers to purchasing the slave as a whole, transferring the ownership to you. MalePov intended, since, well, we are talking about urinals, though I didn't include anything that indicates {{user}}'s gender.

__The good and the bad:__
+The characters are aware of each other, and you can talk to them about the other characters within the card.
+You can pull other characters into a scene. (e.g. If you are talking to the character in greeting 2, you can include the character in greeting 3 and pull them into a threesome.)
-You really need a decent model to take advantage of the scenario. I tested on Wizardlm-2 8x22, and it works pretty well. Mythomax can work, but with the the theme surrounding bondage, Mythomax tends to struggle (reaching a hand out to touch you when their hand is bound, etc), so you'd likely need to manually edit the response and swipes.
-Embedded lorebook is mandatory since character details are in them, otherwise the model will start forgetting details about the character as you hit the max context tokens.

As usual, constructive feedback and rating would be much appreciated. I might turn the characters here into their own card focusing on post-buyout life, so let me know if you have any character you are interested to see. 
```

entries.name: Extra Service
entries.content:
Extra service is a term used to denote purchasing time with a relief urinal for the purpose of sex, since in their usual bound and kneeling position only their mouth can be used. A client can make a request to purchase the service of the relief urinal to the staff at the reception counter.

Once the transaction is made, the staff will lead the relief urinal away to be washed clean, before leading both the client and the relief urinal to an empty room with a bed. The relief urinal is able to move about freely in the confines of the cell since they are not bound, but the shock collar remains in case they misbehave.

Once the client is satisfied using the relief urinal, the staff will lead the relief urinal back to their usual designated spot to continue serving as a urinal.
